otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee mechanics provision (not a restrictive covenant family); concerns the Administrative Agent's/Lenders' discretion not to pursue other obligors before enforcing the guarantee.
description: Grants the Administrative Agent or any Lender discretion, but no obligation, to make a similar demand on or pursue rights and remedies against any Borrower, other Group Member, other Guarantor, other Person, or any collateral security, guarantee, or right of offset before or instead of pursuing a Guarantor.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee mechanics provision preserving the guarantor's continuing liability; not tied to a specific financial covenant family.
description: Provides that any failure by the Administrative Agent or Lenders to demand, pursue remedies, collect payments, or realize upon collateral or a guarantee, or to exercise a right of offset, against other obligors or collateral shall not relieve the Guarantor of its obligations or liability under the guarantee.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee mechanics provision concerning release of co-obligors/collateral; not tied to a specific financial covenant family.
description: States that any release by the Administrative Agent or Lenders of any Borrower, other Group Member, other Guarantor, other Person, or any collateral security, guarantee, or right of offset shall not relieve the Guarantor of its obligations or impair the Administrative Agent's/Lenders' rights and remedies against the Guarantor.

otherFamilyDescription: Interpretive/definitional clause clarifying scope of the term 'demand' as used in the guarantee provisions; included because it affects the operative scope of the waiver/non-impairment rules above.
description: Clarifies that, for purposes of this Section, 'demand' includes the commencement and continuance of legal proceedings.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee/suretyship obligation - not a spending, debt, lien, or restricted payment covenant family
description: Each Guarantor jointly and severally, unconditionally and irrevocably guarantees prompt and complete payment and performance of the Primary Obligations of the Borrowers (excluding its own).

otherFamilyDescription: Cap on guarantor's maximum liability under guarantee/suretyship obligation, tied to fraudulent transfer/insolvency law limits
description: Caps each Guarantor's maximum liability under the guarantee and other Loan Documents at the amount permitted under applicable insolvency laws, after giving effect to contribution rights under Section 2.2.

otherFamilyDescription: Non-impairment provision for guarantee obligation despite fluctuation in underlying obligations
description: Provides that fluctuations (including increases) in the amount of Primary Obligations beyond a Guarantor's liability do not impair the guarantee or affect the Agent's/Secured Parties' rights and remedies.

otherFamilyDescription: Duration/continuation of guarantee obligation until satisfaction of obligations and termination of commitments
description: Specifies that the guarantee remains in full force and effect until all Primary Obligations (excluding certain Swap Agreement and contingent/indemnification obligations not yet due) are paid in full, no Letters of Credit are outstanding, and Commitments are terminated, regardless of intervening periods when Group Members have no Primary Obligations.

otherFamilyDescription: Non-impairment/reinstatement provision protecting guarantee obligation against reduction from certain payments received
description: Provides that payments made or received by/from parties other than the Guarantor itself (via action, proceeding, set-off, or otherwise) in reduction of Primary Obligations do not reduce or release a Guarantor's liability, which continues up to its maximum liability until obligations are paid in full, Letters of Credit are no longer outstanding, and Commitments are terminated.

otherFamilyDescription: Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): GUARANTEE_AND_SURETYSHIP
description: Grants each Subsidiary Guarantor a right of contribution against other Subsidiary Guarantors for payments exceeding its proportionate share of guaranteed obligations.

otherFamilyDescription: Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): GUARANTEE_AND_SURETYSHIP
description: Makes the right of contribution subject to the terms and conditions set forth in Section 2.3.

otherFamilyDescription: Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): GUARANTEE_AND_SURETYSHIP
description: Clarifies that the contribution right does not limit each Subsidiary Guarantor's obligations and liabilities to the Administrative Agent and Lenders.

otherFamilyDescription: Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): GUARANTEE_AND_SURETYSHIP
description: Confirms each Subsidiary Guarantor remains fully liable to the Administrative Agent and Lenders for the full amount it guaranteed, regardless of contribution rights.

otherFamilyDescription: Provision concerns waiver of a guarantor's subrogation, contribution, and reimbursement rights, not a debt/lien/investment/restricted payment basket type covenant.
description: Each Guarantor waives any right of subrogation, contribution, or reimbursement against the Borrower, other Group Members, or other Guarantors until all Primary Obligations are paid in full, no Letters of Credit remain outstanding, and the Commitments are terminated.

otherFamilyDescription: Provision concerns handling of amounts received in violation of the subrogation waiver, not a typical debt/lien basket.
description: If any amount is paid to a Guarantor on account of subrogation rights before the Primary Obligations are paid in full, that amount must be held in trust, segregated, and promptly turned over to the Administrative Agent for application against the Primary Obligations.
Each Guarantor remains obligated under the guarantee notwithstanding any reservation of rights, lack of notice, or lack of further assent by the Guarantor.
Permits the Administrative Agent or any Lender to rescind a demand for payment of Primary Obligations and to continue any Primary Obligations without affecting the Guarantor's liability.

Permits the Administrative Agent or any Lender to renew, extend, amend, modify, accelerate, compromise, waive, surrender, or release the Primary Obligations, the liability of any other person thereon, or any collateral security, guarantee, or right of offset securing them, without discharging the Guarantor.

Permits the Administrative Agent (or Required Lenders/all Lenders as applicable) to amend, modify, supplement, or terminate the Credit Agreement and other Loan Documents in whole or in part without releasing the Guarantor's obligations.
Permits any collateral security, guarantee, or right of offset held for payment of the Primary Obligations to be sold, exchanged, waived, surrendered, or released without discharging the Guarantor.

States that neither the Administrative Agent nor any Lender has any obligation to protect, secure, perfect, or insure any Lien held as security for the Primary Obligations or the guarantee, effectively waiving any such duty that might otherwise limit or discharge the Guarantor's liability.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee obligation - waiver of notice rights related to creation/renewal of primary obligations
description: Each Guarantor waives all notice of the creation, renewal, extension or accrual of Primary Obligations and notice/proof of reliance or acceptance of the guarantee.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee obligation - conclusive presumption of reliance on guarantee for creation/modification of obligations
description: Primary Obligations are conclusively deemed to have been created, contracted, incurred, renewed, extended, amended or waived in reliance upon the guarantee in this Section 2.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee obligation - conclusive presumption regarding dealings between Group Members and lenders
description: All dealings between Group Members with Primary Obligations and the Administrative Agent/Lenders are conclusively presumed to have been consummated in reliance upon the guarantee.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee obligation - waiver of procedural defenses (diligence, presentment, protest, demand, notice of default)
description: Each Guarantor waives diligence, presentment, protest, demand for payment and notice of default or nonpayment with respect to the Primary Obligations.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee obligation - characterization as continuing, absolute and unconditional guarantee of payment
description: The guarantee is to be construed as a continuing, absolute and unconditional guarantee of payment, introducing the list of non-impairing circumstances in clauses (a)-(c).

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee obligation - non-impairment despite validity/enforceability or collateral/right-of-offset issues
description: The guarantee remains unconditional regardless of the validity or enforceability of the Credit Agreement or other Loan Documents, the Primary Obligations, or any collateral security, guarantee, or right of offset held by the Administrative Agent or Lenders.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee obligation - non-impairment despite defenses/setoff/counterclaim, with carve-out for defense of payment or performance
description: The guarantee remains unconditional despite any defense, set-off or counterclaim available to or asserted by any Borrower or other Person against the Administrative Agent or Lenders, except for a defense of payment or performance.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee obligation - carve-out preserving defense of payment or performance
description: Clause (b) expressly excepts from the waived defenses any defense of payment or performance, preserving that specific defense for the Guarantor.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee obligation - non-impairment despite other circumstances constituting equitable or legal discharge
description: The guarantee remains unconditional notwithstanding any other circumstance (with or without notice or knowledge) that might constitute or be construed as an equitable or legal discharge of any Group Member or the Guarantor.

otherFamilyDescription: Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): Guarantee
description: The guarantee under Section 2 remains effective or is automatically reinstated if any payment on the Primary Obligations is rescinded, restored, or returned due to insolvency, bankruptcy, dissolution, liquidation, reorganization, or appointment of a receiver/trustee for any Borrower, Group Member with Primary Obligations, or Guarantor, as if such payment had never been made.

otherFamilyDescription: Keepwell/support obligation ensuring ECP status for swap obligations; not a typical negative covenant basket but a guarantee-type support undertaking.
description: Each Qualified Keepwell Provider jointly and severally, absolutely and irrevocably undertakes to provide funds or support so that each other Guarantor qualifies as an eligible contract participant under the CEA in respect of Swap Obligations during the Swap Guarantee Eligibility Period.

otherFamilyDescription: Fraudulent-transfer savings clause capping keepwell liability, analogous to liability caps found in guarantee provisions.
description: Limits each Qualified Keepwell Provider's liability under Section 2.8 to the maximum amount that would not render its obligations voidable under applicable fraudulent conveyance/fraudulent transfer law.

otherFamilyDescription: Non-impairment/duration clause for the keepwell obligation, akin to standard guarantee continuation provisions.
description: Provides that the Qualified Keepwell Provider's obligations under Section 2.8 remain in full force and effect until the Loans, Reimbursement Obligations and other Obligations (excluding certain Swap and contingent/indemnification obligations) are paid in full, the Commitments are terminated, and no Letters of Credit remain outstanding.

otherFamilyDescription: Regulatory characterization clause deeming the section a 'keepwell, support, or other agreement' for CEA eligible contract participant purposes; not tied to a listed covenant family.
description: States the intent and deems Section 2.8 to constitute a 'keepwell, support, or other agreement' for purposes of section 1a(18)(A)(v)(II) of the Commodity Exchange Act.

description: Excludes any Receivable that remains subject to a security interest granted under a Receivables Transfer Program permitted by the Credit Agreement.

Excludes property of GWH, Ltd or Largo Lakes-I Limited Partnership (or successors/permitted transferees) held in connection with the Largo Acquisition so long as it remains subject to a security interest granted in connection with that acquisition.

otherFamilyDescription: Interpretive rule adjusting knowledge qualifier in incorporated representations | Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): OTHER
description: Provides that references to the Parent Borrower's knowledge in the incorporated representations shall be deemed references to such Guarantor's knowledge for purposes of this Section.

Grantor represents that no financing statement or other public notice covering the Collateral is on file except those filed for the Administrative Agent or otherwise permitted by the Credit Agreement.

otherFamilyDescription: Intellectual property licensing carve-out from the definition of Lien
description: Clarifies that a Grantor's grant of licenses to third parties to use its owned or controlled Intellectual Property, in the ordinary course of business, does not constitute a Lien for purposes of this Agreement and the other Loan Documents.

otherFamilyDescription: Acknowledgment of effect of exclusive IP licenses on Agent's remedies; not itself a restriction or permission
description: Administrative Agent and Lenders acknowledge that exclusive licenses of Intellectual Property may limit the Agent's ability to utilize, sell, lease or transfer such Intellectual Property in realizing on the Collateral.

otherFamilyDescription: Perfection of security interests / collateral perfection representation | Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): OTHER
description: States that upon completion of the filings and actions listed on Schedule 3, the security interests granted will constitute valid, perfected, first priority security interests in the Collateral enforceable against third parties.

otherFamilyDescription: Lien priority representation with carve-out for Permitted Liens under the Credit Agreement | Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): OTHER
description: Represents that the security interests are prior to all other Liens on the Collateral existing as of the date hereof, except for Liens permitted by the Credit Agreement.

otherFamilyDescription: This is a representation regarding organizational jurisdiction and chief executive office location, not an operative covenant restricting any CovenantFamily activity.
description: Represents that the Grantor's jurisdiction of organization, organizational ID number, and location of chief executive office/principal place of business are as specified on Schedule 4.

otherFamilyDescription: This is a representation confirming delivery of organizational documents to the Administrative Agent, not a covenant restricting a CovenantFamily.
description: Represents that the Grantor has furnished the Administrative Agent with a certified charter/certificate of incorporation and a recent long-form good standing certificate.

otherFamilyDescription: Collateral location representation (not a standard covenant family)

otherFamilyDescription: Collateral location exception

otherFamilyDescription: Collateral location exception
description: Excludes goods in transit from the Schedule 5 location representation.

otherFamilyDescription: Collateral location exception
description: Excludes samples, loaners, or demonstration equipment from the Schedule 5 location representation.

otherFamilyDescription: Collateral location exception
description: Excludes tooling equipment held at vendors' locations from the Schedule 5 location representation.

description: Grantor represents that the pledged shares constitute all issued and outstanding Capital Stock of each Issuer, except that for Foreign Subsidiary Voting Stock only 65% of such stock is pledged.

otherFamilyDescription: Boilerplate representation about validity/non-assessability of pledged shares; does not map to a substantive covenant family.
description: Grantor represents that all shares of Pledged Stock have been duly and validly issued and are fully paid and nonassessable.

otherFamilyDescription: Relates to enforceability of Pledged Notes (debt instruments) above a $1,000,000 threshold, functioning like a de minimis/basket threshold for which notes must be enforceable/collateralized.
description: Grantor represents that Pledged Notes in excess of $1,000,000 constitute legal, valid, and binding obligations enforceable against the obligor, subject to standard bankruptcy/equity qualifications.

otherFamilyDescription: Concerns Intercompany Notes issued in connection with Indebtedness permitted under specific Credit Agreement sections (7.8(i) and 7.2(k)); ties representation validity to compliance with those debt-incurrence covenants.
description: Grantor represents that any Intercompany Note issued in connection with Indebtedness incurred under Credit Agreement Sections 7.8(i) and 7.2(k) is a legal, valid, and binding obligation of the obligor.

otherFamilyDescription: Representation of ownership and lien-free title to Investment Property, subject to the security interest created by this Agreement and other Liens permitted under the Credit Agreement (a negative-pledge style exception).
description: Grantor represents it holds good and marketable title to the pledged Investment Property free of all Liens or claims except the security interest granted hereunder and other Liens permitted by the Credit Agreement.

otherFamilyDescription: Collateral/security perfection representation concerning Receivables not otherwise fitting a defined covenant family
description: Represents that no amount payable under a Receivable is evidenced by an undelivered Instrument or Chattel Paper, to the extent required by the Credit Agreement.

otherFamilyDescription: Threshold/basket limiting the concentration of governmental-obligor Receivables, not tied to a standard covenant family
description: Caps Receivables owed by Governmental Authorities at 5% of the Parent Borrower's and its Subsidiaries' consolidated Receivables.

otherFamilyDescription: General accuracy representation about Receivables balances, not tied to a specific covenant family
description: Represents that amounts reported to Lenders as owing on Receivables will be accurate in all material respects.

otherFamilyDescription: Intellectual property disclosure/schedule reference; not a covenant restriction
description: States that Schedule 6 lists all registrations and applications for Owned Intellectual Property held by the Grantor as of the date hereof.

otherFamilyDescription: Representation regarding validity/enforceability/non-infringement of intellectual property, not a covenant on a defined CovenantFamily
description: Represents that, except as disclosed on Schedule 4.9, all material owned or exclusively held Intellectual Property is valid, unexpired, enforceable, not abandoned, and non-infringing as of the date hereof.

otherFamilyDescription: Representation as to absence of licensing/franchise agreements over IP
description: Represents that, except as set forth in Schedule 6, none of the owned or exclusively held Intellectual Property is subject to a written licensing or franchise agreement under which the Grantor is licensor or franchisor.

otherFamilyDescription: Representation regarding absence of adverse judgments affecting IP rights
description: Represents that no governmental holding, decision, or judgment has been rendered limiting, cancelling, or questioning the validity of or the Grantor's rights in any Intellectual Property in a manner that could reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect.

otherFamilyDescription: Representation regarding absence of pending or threatened IP-related litigation
description: Represents that no action or proceeding is pending or, to the Grantor's knowledge, threatened in writing seeking to limit, cancel, or question the validity or ownership of any Intellectual Property, or that would otherwise have a material adverse effect on its value.

otherFamilyDescription: General framework covenant clause establishing the temporal scope during which Grantors' covenants remain in effect; no specific covenant obligations are stated in the provided text.
description: Each Grantor agrees to be bound by the covenants set forth in this Section 5 from the date of the Agreement until all Obligations (excluding certain Swap Agreement and contingent/indemnification obligations) are paid in full, no Letters of Credit are outstanding, and Commitments have terminated.

otherFamilyDescription: This provision incorporates by reference all affirmative and negative covenants applicable to a Subsidiary of the Parent Borrower under the Credit Agreement, effectively covering every covenant family (e.g., indebtedness, liens, restricted payments, asset sales, etc.) without specifying which.
description: Requires each Guarantor to comply with (take or refrain from taking) every action that a Subsidiary of the Parent Borrower is required or prohibited from taking under the Credit Agreement's covenants.

otherFamilyDescription: Collateral/security interest maintenance obligation, not a financial or negative covenant family
description: Grantor must maintain the security interest as a perfected interest with priority per Section 4.3 and defend it against all claims, subject to disposal rights under the Loan Documents.

otherFamilyDescription: Reporting/informational covenant related to collateral, not a standard covenant family
description: Grantor must furnish statements, schedules and reports identifying its assets and property to the Administrative Agent upon reasonable request.

otherFamilyDescription: Further assurances / perfection covenant concerning collateral, not a standard covenant family
description: Grantor must execute and deliver further instruments, file financing statements, and take actions (including obtaining control over Investment Property, Deposit Accounts, and Letter-of-Credit Rights) to preserve and perfect the security interest, at Grantor's expense.

otherFamilyDescription: Perfection mechanics - UCC filings
description: Specifies that further actions include filing financing or continuation statements under the UCC or similar laws in applicable jurisdictions.

otherFamilyDescription: Perfection mechanics - control agreements
description: Specifies that for Investment Property, Deposit Accounts, and Letter-of-Credit Rights, Grantor must take actions to enable the Administrative Agent to obtain 'control' under the UCC.

otherFamilyDescription: Restriction on change of jurisdiction of organization to protect perfected security interest, not a standard covenant family
description: Grantor may not change its jurisdiction of organization unless it provides 15 days' prior written notice and delivers additional financing statements/documents and, if applicable, a supplement to Schedule 5 showing new Inventory/Equipment locations.

otherFamilyDescription: Documentation condition precedent to jurisdiction change
description: Requires delivery of all additional executed financing statements and other documents reasonably requested to maintain validity, perfection, and priority of the security interests as a precondition to changing jurisdiction.

otherFamilyDescription: Schedule update condition precedent to jurisdiction change
description: Requires delivery of a written supplement to Schedule 5 identifying any additional location where Inventory or Equipment will be kept, if applicable, as a precondition to changing jurisdiction.

description: Requires Grantor to accept, hold in trust, and forthwith deliver to the Administrative Agent (with stock powers) any new stock certificates, options, or rights received in respect of pledged Capital Stock, to be held as additional collateral security.

description: Requires that sums paid upon liquidation or dissolution of an Issuer in respect of Investment Property be paid over to the Administrative Agent as additional collateral, except as permitted by the Credit Agreement.

otherFamilyDescription: Handling of distributed capital/property from recapitalization or reorganization | Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): Security/Collateral
description: Requires delivery to the Administrative Agent of any capital or property distributed in respect of Investment Property due to recapitalization, reclassification, or reorganization, unless already subject to a perfected security interest in favor of the Administrative Agent.

otherFamilyDescription: Compliance covenant by Issuer with pledge terms applicable to it
description: Obligates each Issuer-Grantor to be bound by and comply with the terms of the Agreement relating to Investment Property it issued.

description: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Grantor may abandon, forfeit, or dedicate IP to the public in its reasonable business judgment absent a Material Adverse Effect, and may sell or dispose of Intellectual Property in compliance with Section 7.5 of the Credit Agreement.

otherFamilyDescription: Proviso limiting the abandonment exception based on materiality threshold defined elsewhere.
description: The abandonment/forfeiture exception in (j) only applies if the act or omission does not cause a Material Adverse Effect on Grantor's business.

otherFamilyDescription: Cross-reference permitting disposition of IP under a separate asset-disposition covenant (Section 7.5 of Credit Agreement), likely corresponding to an Asset Sales/Dispositions covenant family.
description: Grantor may sell or dispose of Intellectual Property so long as such disposition complies with Section 7.5 of the Credit Agreement governing asset dispositions.

otherFamilyDescription: Collateral administration / verification rights not tied to a standard covenant family
description: Grants the Administrative Agent the right to conduct test verifications of Receivables and requires each Grantor to furnish assistance, information, and third-party accountant reports upon request.

otherFamilyDescription: Collateral control/cash management mechanics for receivables collection, not a standard covenant family
description: Authorizes each Grantor to collect its own Receivables (or arrange third-party collection) subject to the Administrative Agent's direction and control, with that authority terminable by the Administrative Agent upon an Event of Default.

otherFamilyDescription: Collateral/cash sweep mechanics upon default, akin to a security-interest perfection/control provision
description: Upon Administrative Agent's request during an Event of Default, requires Grantors to deposit collected Receivable payments into a controlled Collateral Account within two Business Days and to hold such funds in trust pending deposit, with accompanying identification reports.

otherFamilyDescription: Document delivery/collateral administration obligation, not tied to a standard covenant family
description: Requires each Grantor to make available, or upon a Default or Event of Default to deliver, all original documents evidencing Receivables constituting Collateral, including orders, invoices, and shipping receipts.

otherFamilyDescription: Administrative/servicing rights over Receivables collateral (not a standard covenant family)
description: Permits the Administrative Agent, after an Event of Default occurs and continues, to communicate directly with obligors on Receivables to verify existence, amount and terms of Receivables constituting Collateral.

otherFamilyDescription: Administrative/servicing rights over Receivables collateral
description: The Administrative Agent's right to contact obligors is triggered by and conditioned on the occurrence and continuance of an Event of Default.

otherFamilyDescription: Administrative/servicing rights over Receivables collateral
description: Requires each Grantor, upon written request of the Administrative Agent after an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing, to notify Receivables obligors that Receivables have been assigned and that payment must be made directly to the Administrative Agent.

otherFamilyDescription: Grantor's continuing performance obligations under assigned Receivables (not a standard covenant family)
description: States that each Grantor remains liable to observe and perform all obligations under the Receivables notwithstanding the collateral assignment, i.e., the Grantor's underlying contractual duties are not discharged.

otherFamilyDescription: Limitation of Administrative Agent/Lender liability regarding Receivables
description: Disclaims any obligation or liability of the Administrative Agent or any Lender under the Receivables or related agreements arising from this Agreement or receipt of payments, and states they need not perform Grantor obligations, make payments, investigate, present claims, or enforce collection.

otherFamilyDescription: Carve-out from receivables collateral administration provisions for receivables in a permitted Receivables Transfer Program
description: Provides that Sections 6.1 and 6.2 do not apply to any Receivable that remains subject to a security interest granted under, or is otherwise designated for inclusion in, a Receivables Transfer Program permitted by the Credit Agreement.

otherFamilyDescription: Collateral/security agreement provision regarding dividend and voting rights on pledged stock, not a traditional covenant family (debt, liens, restricted payments, etc.)
description: Absent a continuing Event of Default and notice from the Administrative Agent of intent to exercise Section 6.3(b) rights, each Grantor may retain cash dividends on Pledged Stock and payments on Pledged Notes paid in the ordinary course and exercise voting/organizational rights over Investment Property, subject to a proviso barring any vote or action that would impair the Collateral or violate the Credit Agreement or Loan Documents.

otherFamilyDescription: Security/collateral enforcement provision, not a covenant family concerning debt, liens, or payments in the traditional sense
description: Upon occurrence and continuance of an Event of Default and notice from the Administrative Agent, the Agent gains the right to receive all dividends, payments and proceeds of Investment Property and to apply them to the Obligations, and to have the Investment Property registered in its name and exercise all voting, conversion, exchange and other rights as if absolute owner, without liability except to account for property actually received.

otherFamilyDescription: Security agreement mechanics directing third-party Issuer compliance upon default notice; not a substantive covenant family
description: Each Grantor authorizes and instructs each Issuer of pledged Investment Property to comply with written Administrative Agent instructions stating an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing and that conform to this Agreement, without further instruction from the Grantor, and provides that the Issuer is fully protected in so complying.

otherFamilyDescription: Security agreement provision directing payment flow of dividends on pledged collateral; not a traditional covenant family
description: Unless otherwise expressly permitted under the Agreement, each Issuer is instructed to pay dividends or other payments on the Investment Property directly to the Administrative Agent rather than the Grantor.

otherFamilyDescription: Application-of-proceeds waterfall mechanics; not a debt/lien/restricted-payment style covenant family
description: Grants the Administrative Agent authority (at agreed intervals, or unilaterally after an Event of Default) to apply Collateral proceeds and guarantee proceeds to the Obligations in a specified order.

otherFamilyDescription: Payment waterfall - priority tier for Administrative Agent fees/expenses
description: Establishes that proceeds are applied first to pay incurred and unpaid fees and expenses of the Administrative Agent under the Loan Documents.

otherFamilyDescription: Payment waterfall - second priority pro rata payment of Obligations
description: Provides that proceeds are applied second, pro rata among Secured Parties, toward amounts of the Obligations then due and owing and unpaid.

otherFamilyDescription: Payment waterfall - third priority pro rata prepayment of Obligations
description: Provides that any remaining proceeds are applied third, pro rata among Secured Parties, toward prepayment of the Obligations then held.

otherFamilyDescription: Payment waterfall - residual return of surplus proceeds after full satisfaction of Obligations
description: States that any balance remaining after the Obligations are paid in full, Letters of Credit are no longer outstanding, and Commitments have terminated shall be returned to the Borrowers or whoever is lawfully entitled.

otherFamilyDescription: Swap Obligations carve-out limiting application of Guarantor-sourced proceeds
description: Provides that notwithstanding the application waterfall, no amounts received from any Guarantor shall be applied to that Guarantor's Excluded Swap Obligations.

otherFamilyDescription: General remedies/enforcement provision of a security agreement, not a substantive covenant restriction tied to a specific covenant family
description: Upon the occurrence and continuation of an Event of Default, the Administrative Agent may exercise all rights and remedies under the Agreement, other transaction documents, and the UCC or other applicable law.

otherFamilyDescription: Enforcement/remedies waiver provision
description: Each Grantor waives demand of performance, presentment, protest, advertisement and notice of any kind (except notice required by law) in connection with the Administrative Agent's exercise of remedies.

otherFamilyDescription: Enforcement/remedies permission over collateral
description: The Administrative Agent may collect, receive, appropriate, and realize upon, or sell, lease, assign, grant options to purchase, or otherwise dispose of the Collateral in one or more parcels at public or private sale on terms and at prices it deems advisable.

otherFamilyDescription: Enforcement/remedies waiver provision
description: The Administrative Agent or any Lender may purchase the whole or part of the Collateral at any such sale free of any right or equity of redemption, which each Grantor waives and releases.

otherFamilyDescription: Enforcement/remedies obligation of Grantor
description: Each Grantor agrees, upon the Administrative Agent's request, to assemble the Collateral and make it available at a place reasonably selected by the Administrative Agent.

otherFamilyDescription: Proceeds waterfall/application provision referencing Section 6.5
description: Net proceeds from remedial actions, after deduction of reasonable costs and expenses (including attorneys' fees) incurred in connection with collection or safekeeping of Collateral, are to be applied to the Obligations in the order set forth in Section 6.5.

otherFamilyDescription: Surplus accounting exception tied to statutory requirement (UCC 9-615(a)(3))
description: The Administrative Agent need only account for any surplus after application of proceeds and payment of other legally required amounts under UCC Section 9-615(a)(3).

otherFamilyDescription: Enforcement/remedies waiver of claims against Agent/Lenders
description: Each Grantor waives, to the extent permitted by applicable law, all claims, damages, and demands it may have against the Administrative Agent or any Lender arising from their exercise of remedies under this section.

otherFamilyDescription: Deemed-reasonable notice period safe harbor for sale of Collateral
description: If notice of a proposed sale or disposition of Collateral is required by law, a notice given at least 10 days before the sale is deemed reasonable and proper.

otherFamilyDescription: Procedural obligation requiring Grantor to cause Issuer to register Pledged Stock for sale; not a financial/covenant-family restriction but a collateral-enforcement mechanic.
description: Requires each Grantor to cause the Issuer of Pledged Stock to take all necessary registration actions under the Securities Act if the Administrative Agent decides to sell the Pledged Stock and registration is deemed advisable.

otherFamilyDescription: Registration mechanics for collateral sale, not a covenant family restriction.
description: Obligates the Issuer's directors and officers to execute and deliver all instruments and documents necessary to effect registration of the Pledged Stock as directed by the Administrative Agent.

otherFamilyDescription: Registration maintenance obligation tied to collateral sale process.
description: Requires use of reasonable best efforts to have the registration statement become and remain effective for one year following the first public offering of the Pledged Stock.

otherFamilyDescription: Registration amendment obligation.
description: Requires making all amendments to the registration statement and related prospectus deemed necessary or advisable by the Administrative Agent to conform to Securities Act requirements.

otherFamilyDescription: Ancillary compliance obligations tied to registration of pledged securities.
description: Requires Grantors to cause the Issuer to comply with applicable state 'Blue Sky' securities laws and to make available an earnings statement satisfying Section 11(a) of the Securities Act.

otherFamilyDescription: Protective provision limiting Administrative Agent's obligations regarding sale method and timing of pledged collateral.
description: Acknowledges that the Administrative Agent may need to conduct private rather than public sales of Pledged Stock, deems such private sales commercially reasonable notwithstanding less favorable terms, and excuses the Agent from any obligation to delay sale to permit registration.

otherFamilyDescription: Obligation to assist in making collateral sales legally valid.
description: Requires each Grantor to use best efforts to take all acts necessary to make any sale of Pledged Stock valid, binding, and compliant with applicable law.

otherFamilyDescription: Remedies and waiver provision related to breach of registration covenants.
description: Grantor agrees that breach of Section 6.7 covenants causes irreparable harm with no adequate legal remedy, agrees such covenants are specifically enforceable, and waives all defenses to a specific performance action except the defense that no Event of Default has occurred.

otherFamilyDescription: This is a deficiency-liability provision related to secured party remedies upon collateral disposition, not a debt/lien/investment/restricted-payment type covenant family.
description: Each Grantor remains personally liable for any shortfall between collateral sale proceeds and the Obligations, including collection-related attorneys' fees and disbursements.

otherFamilyDescription: Grant of power of attorney to Administrative Agent to act on behalf of each Grantor with respect to Collateral; not a financial or negative covenant family.
description: Each Grantor irrevocably appoints the Administrative Agent (and its officers/agents) as attorney-in-fact with broad authority to execute documents and take actions necessary to accomplish the purposes of the Agreement with respect to the Collateral.

otherFamilyDescription: Condition limiting exercise of the power-of-attorney grant to periods when an Event of Default is continuing; administrative/security enforcement mechanic rather than a covenant family.
description: The Administrative Agent agrees not to exercise the power of attorney granted under Section 7.1(a) unless an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing.

otherFamilyDescription: Specific enumerated attorney-in-fact power over receivables collection, not a covenant family.
description: Authorizes the Administrative Agent to take possession of, endorse, and collect checks, drafts, notes and other instruments and to pursue legal action to collect amounts due on Receivables or other Collateral.

otherFamilyDescription: Power to execute documentation evidencing the security interest in Intellectual Property Collateral.
description: Authorizes the Administrative Agent to execute, deliver and record agreements or documents evidencing the Administrative Agent's and Secured Parties' security interest in a Grantor's Intellectual Property and related goodwill/general intangibles.

otherFamilyDescription: Administrative power to pay taxes/liens and effect insurance on Collateral; not a covenant family per se.
description: Authorizes the Administrative Agent to pay or discharge taxes and Liens on the Collateral and to effect and pay for required insurance.

otherFamilyDescription: Power to execute conveyance instruments in connection with permitted collateral sales under other sections; cross-references Sections 6.6/6.7.
description: Authorizes the Administrative Agent to execute indorsements, assignments or other conveyance instruments with respect to Collateral in connection with sales provided for in Section 6.6 or 6.7.

otherFamilyDescription: Umbrella clause enumerating multiple sub-powers (1)-(8) of the attorney-in-fact grant.
description: Grants the Administrative Agent a broad set of enumerated powers (directing payment, collecting amounts due, signing documents, prosecuting/defending suits, settling claims, assigning IP, and generally dealing with Collateral) exercisable after an Event of Default.

otherFamilyDescription: Specific sub-power to settle or compromise litigation relating to Collateral.
description: Authorizes the Administrative Agent to settle, compromise or adjust any suit, action or proceeding relating to the Collateral and to give discharges or releases as it deems appropriate.

otherFamilyDescription: Broad enforcement power allowing the agent to deal with Collateral as if absolute owner; closely related to security enforcement rights.
description: Authorizes the Administrative Agent, at its option and the Grantor's expense, to sell, transfer, pledge and otherwise deal with the Collateral as fully as if it were the absolute owner, taking any action deemed necessary to protect, preserve or realize on the Collateral and the security interests therein.

otherFamilyDescription: Permission for the Administrative Agent to cure a Grantor's non-performance after a Default/Event of Default; administrative remedy rather than a covenant family.
description: If a Grantor fails to perform or comply with its agreements under the Agreement or Section 6.10 of the Credit Agreement after a Default or Event of Default, the Administrative Agent may (but is not obligated to) perform or cause performance of such agreement.

otherFamilyDescription: Reimbursement/interest obligation for Administrative Agent's expenses incurred exercising Section 7.1 powers; not tied to a covenant family.
description: Requires the relevant Grantor to reimburse the Administrative Agent on demand for expenses incurred under Section 7.1, together with interest at the ABR past-due Revolving Credit Loan rate from payment until reimbursement.

otherFamilyDescription: Ratification and irrevocability provision for the powers of attorney granted; functions like a waiver of revocation rights until termination/release.
description: Each Grantor ratifies all acts lawfully done under the powers of attorney and confirms that the powers, authorizations and agencies in the Agreement are coupled with an interest and irrevocable until the Agreement terminates and the security interests are released.

otherFamilyDescription: Agent's collateral custody duty standard
description: Establishes that the Administrative Agent's sole duty regarding custody, safekeeping, and preservation of Collateral is to treat it as it treats similar property for its own account.

otherFamilyDescription: Limitation of liability for collection/realization on collateral
description: Provides that the Administrative Agent, Lenders, and their respective officers, directors, employees or agents are not liable for failure or delay in demanding, collecting, or realizing upon Collateral, and are under no obligation to sell or dispose of Collateral or take other action regarding it.

otherFamilyDescription: Scope limitation on powers granted over collateral
description: Clarifies that the powers conferred on the Administrative Agent and Lenders are solely to protect their interests in the Collateral and do not impose any duty to exercise such powers.

otherFamilyDescription: Accountability limitation and exculpation from liability except for gross negligence/willful misconduct
description: Limits the Administrative Agent's and Lenders' accountability to amounts actually received from exercise of powers and exculpates them and their agents from liability for acts or omissions except gross negligence or willful misconduct.

otherFamilyDescription: Administrative/agency boilerplate clarifying the Administrative Agent's authority vis-à-vis Lenders and Grantors; not a covenant restriction
description: Clarifies that as between the Administrative Agent and Lenders, the Agent's actions are governed by the Credit Agreement and related inter-lender agreements.

otherFamilyDescription: Conclusive presumption of authority protecting the Agent from Grantor challenge; functions like a waiver of inquiry right
description: Provides that as between the Administrative Agent and Grantors, the Agent is conclusively presumed to have full authority to act or refrain from acting on behalf of the Lenders, and no Grantor has any obligation or right to inquire into that authority.

otherFamilyDescription: Boilerplate no-waiver/cumulative remedies provision; not a covenant restriction
description: Provides that no act, delay, or omission by the Administrative Agent or any Lender (other than a written instrument under Section 8.1) constitutes a waiver of rights or acquiescence in a Default or Event of Default.

otherFamilyDescription: Boilerplate no-waiver/cumulative remedies provision; not a covenant restriction
description: States that no failure or delay in exercising any right, power, or privilege operates as a waiver of that right.

otherFamilyDescription: Boilerplate no-waiver/cumulative remedies provision; not a covenant restriction
description: Provides that a single or partial exercise of any right does not preclude further exercise of that or any other right.

otherFamilyDescription: Boilerplate no-waiver/cumulative remedies provision; not a covenant restriction
description: Clarifies that a waiver of a right on one occasion does not bar exercise of that right on a future occasion.

otherFamilyDescription: Boilerplate no-waiver/cumulative remedies provision; not a covenant restriction
description: States that the rights and remedies provided in the agreement are cumulative, may be exercised singly or concurrently, and are non-exclusive of other rights or remedies available by law.

otherFamilyDescription: Expense reimbursement obligation for enforcement costs; not a traditional covenant family (debt, liens, restricted payments, etc.)
description: Each Guarantor must pay or reimburse the Lenders and Administrative Agent for costs and expenses (including counsel fees) incurred in collecting against or enforcing rights under the guarantee and Loan Documents.

otherFamilyDescription: Tax indemnification obligation related to Collateral; not a covenant family per the closed enum.
description: Each Guarantor must pay and indemnify the Administrative Agent and Lenders against stamp, excise, sales or other taxes arising from the Collateral or the transactions contemplated by the Agreement, including liabilities from delay in payment.

otherFamilyDescription: General indemnification obligation tied to a cross-referenced Credit Agreement provision; not a covenant family per closed enum.
description: Each Guarantor must indemnify the Administrative Agent and Lenders against a broad range of liabilities, losses, and expenses arising from execution, delivery, enforcement, performance and administration of the Agreement, to the same extent the Parent Borrower is required under Section 10.5 of the Credit Agreement.

otherFamilyDescription: Survival clause; boilerplate-adjacent but included since it affects duration of obligations under this section.
description: The indemnification and expense reimbursement obligations in Section 8.4 survive repayment of the Obligations and other amounts payable under the Credit Agreement and Loan Documents.

otherFamilyDescription: Assignment/successors boilerplate concerning binding effect of the agreement on successors and assigns
description: Provides that the Agreement binds and benefits the successors and assigns of each Grantor, the Administrative Agent, and the Secured Parties.

otherFamilyDescription: Restriction on a Grantor's ability to assign or delegate its rights/obligations under the agreement, not a financial or operational covenant family
description: Prohibits any Grantor from assigning, transferring, or delegating its rights or obligations under the Agreement without the prior written consent of the Administrative Agent.

otherFamilyDescription: This section grants set-off rights to the Administrative Agent and Lenders rather than restricting Grantor conduct; it does not correspond to a standard covenant family.
description: Each Grantor irrevocably authorizes the Administrative Agent and each Lender, during the continuance of an Event of Default, to set-off and apply any deposits, credits, or claims held for the Grantor against the Grantor's obligations under the Loan Documents.

otherFamilyDescription: Relates to procedural rights (waiver of notice) rather than a covenant family.
description: Each Grantor expressly waives any requirement of prior notice before the Administrative Agent or a Lender exercises its set-off rights.

otherFamilyDescription: Procedural/administrative obligation on the Agent/Lenders, not a covenant on the Grantor.
description: The Administrative Agent or Lender must notify the Grantor promptly after exercising set-off and applying proceeds, though failure to give such notice does not invalidate the set-off.

otherFamilyDescription: Carve-out limiting application of set-off proceeds tied to a defined term (Excluded Swap Obligation) rather than a standard covenant family.
description: To the extent prohibited by law as described in the definition of 'Excluded Swap Obligation,' no amounts received from or set off against a Guarantor may be applied to that Guarantor's Excluded Swap Obligations.

otherFamilyDescription: Boilerplate-like cumulative rights clause preserving other remedies; not tied to a covenant family.
description: The set-off rights under this Section 8.6 are cumulative and in addition to any other rights or remedies, including other rights of set-off, available to the Administrative Agent or Lenders.

otherFamilyDescription: Procedural jurisdiction submission clause, not an economic covenant
description: Each Grantor submits to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of New York state and federal courts for actions relating to the Agreement.

otherFamilyDescription: Procedural venue waiver, not an economic covenant
description: Each Grantor consents to actions being brought in the specified courts and waives objections to venue or forum non conveniens.

otherFamilyDescription: Procedural service-of-process mechanic, not an economic covenant
description: Permits service of process by mail to the Grantor's notice address as an accepted method of service.

otherFamilyDescription: Proviso preserving other lawful means of service/suit, not an economic covenant
description: Clarifies that the foregoing does not limit other lawful methods of service or the right to sue in other jurisdictions.

otherFamilyDescription: Procedural waiver of damages claims, not an economic covenant
description: Each Grantor waives, to the extent permitted by law, any right to claim special, exemplary, punitive, or consequential damages in related legal proceedings.

otherFamilyDescription: This is a joinder/mechanics provision requiring new subsidiaries to become Grantors under the collateral agreement, not a substantive negative covenant restricting indebtedness, liens, investments, etc.
description: Requires each Subsidiary of the Parent Borrower that must become a party to the Agreement under Section 6.9 of the Credit Agreement to become a Grantor by executing and delivering an Assumption Agreement in the form of Annex 1.

Provides that upon full payment and termination of the Loans, Reimbursement Obligations, other Obligations and Commitments (excluding certain contingent obligations), the Liens on the Collateral are automatically released and the Agreement terminates without further act.
Requires the Administrative Agent, at the requesting Grantor's expense, to deliver held Collateral and execute documents evidencing termination of the security interest.

Provides that if Collateral is sold, transferred or otherwise disposed of in a transaction permitted by the Credit Agreement, the Administrative Agent must release the Liens on that Collateral at the disposing Grantor's expense.

Permits a Subsidiary Guarantor to be released from its guarantee obligations when all of its Capital Stock is sold, transferred, or disposed of in a transaction permitted by the Credit Agreement, subject to the Parent Borrower's request.

Conditions the release of a Subsidiary Guarantor on the Parent Borrower delivering, at least ten Business Days prior to the proposed release, a written request identifying the guarantor and disposition terms plus a compliance certification.

otherFamilyDescription: Procedural waiver of jury trial right, not tied to a specific covenant family.
description: Each Grantor irrevocably and unconditionally waives the right to trial by jury in any legal action or proceeding relating to the Agreement or other Loan Documents, including counterclaims.

States that the amendment and restatement of the Existing Guarantee and Collateral Agreement is not intended to constitute, and shall not constitute, a novation or accord and satisfaction of the Obligations or other obligations under the Credit Agreement or Loan Documents.
Confirms that the Liens described in the Existing Guarantee and Collateral Agreement are carried forward and continue in full force and effect to secure the Obligations.

Provides that none of the Liens, properties, rights and interests under the Existing Guarantee and Collateral Agreement are released, impaired, limited, extinguished or novated, and that such Liens are cumulative with those of this Agreement.
Provides that references to the Existing Guarantee and Collateral Agreement in other Loan Documents shall be deemed to refer to this Agreement and its provisions.

Each Grantor grants the Administrative Agent, for the ratable benefit of the Secured Parties, a security interest in substantially all owned and after-acquired property (Accounts, Chattel Paper, Deposit Accounts, Documents, Equipment, General Intangibles, Instruments, Intellectual Property, Inventory, Investment Property, Letter-of-Credit Rights, other property, books/records, and Proceeds/Supporting Obligations/products) as collateral security for the Obligations.

Excludes from the security grant any property to the extent the grant is prohibited by law, requires an unobtained governmental consent, breaches or triggers termination/consent rights under a contract, license or shareholder agreement, or would cause a newly acquired license to become non-exclusive or materially diminished, unless the restriction is ineffective under applicable law.

Excludes Capital Stock of CONMED Receivables Corporation (and similar single-purpose entities used in a Receivables Transfer Program) from the security interest so long as pledging it is prohibited under that program.
Excludes Receivables that remain subject to a security interest granted under a permitted Receivables Transfer Program.

Excludes Capital Stock in a non-Wholly-Owned Subsidiary that is restricted from being pledged under its organizational documents, requires third-party consent not obtained, or would trigger a right of first refusal/offer.
Sub-condition excluding Capital Stock whose pledge is prohibited or restricted by the issuer's organizational or joint venture/shareholder documents.
Sub-condition excluding Capital Stock whose pledge would require a third-party consent not obtained, clarifying no Group Member is required to seek such consent.
Sub-condition excluding Capital Stock whose pledge would trigger an exercisable right of first refusal/offer or similar right held by a non-Group Member.
Excludes Foreign Subsidiary Voting Stock in excess of 65.0% of any Foreign Subsidiary or Foreign Subsidiary Holdco from the security interest.

Excludes assets (including Capital Stock) from the security interest to the extent pledging would cause more than immaterial adverse tax consequences, including under Code Section 956 or similar law, as determined by the Parent Borrower and advised to the Administrative Agent.
Excludes certain deposit accounts used solely for payroll, withheld employment taxes, or amounts payable to an employee benefit plan from the security interest.
Excludes deposit accounts used solely as payroll accounts.
Excludes deposit accounts containing solely withheld income or employment taxes required to be remitted to tax authorities.
Excludes deposit accounts containing solely amounts required to be paid to an employee benefit plan under DOL Reg. Sec. 2510.3-102.

Excludes any asset from the security interest where the Administrative Agent and Parent Borrower reasonably determine, in a written determination, that the cost/burden of perfecting a security interest outweighs the practical benefit to the Lenders.

Excludes Capital Stock of GWH, Ltd or Largo Lakes-I Limited Partnership (or successors/transferees) so long as it remains subject to a security interest granted in connection with the Largo Acquisition.

Excludes property of GWH, Ltd or Largo Lakes-I Limited Partnership (or successors/transferees) held in connection with the Largo Acquisition so long as it remains subject to a security interest granted in connection with that acquisition.

The Administrative Agent or any Lender is not obligated to pursue remedies against any Borrower, other obligated Group Member, other Guarantor, other Person, collateral, guarantee, or right of offset before or instead of demanding payment from a Guarantor.

Failure by the Administrative Agent or any Lender to pursue other rights, remedies, or collections, or any release of any other obligor, collateral, guarantee, or right of offset, does not relieve any Guarantor of its obligations or liability under the guarantee.
Such failure to act or release does not impair or affect the Administrative Agent's or any Lender's express, implied, or legally available rights and remedies against any Guarantor.

otherFamilyDescription: Definitional clause clarifying scope of the term 'demand' as used in the guarantee section, which affects when the Guarantor's non-relief provisions are triggered.
description: For purposes of this section, 'demand' is defined to include the commencement and continuance of any legal proceedings.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee obligation, not a debt/lien/investment-type covenant family
description: Each Guarantor jointly and severally, unconditionally and irrevocably guarantees payment and performance of the Borrowers' Primary Obligations (other than its own) to the Administrative Agent for the ratable benefit of Secured Parties.

otherFamilyDescription: Cap on guarantor liability under fraudulent conveyance/insolvency law, not a standard covenant family
description: Limits each Guarantor's maximum liability under the guarantee and other Loan Documents to the amount permitted under applicable insolvency laws, after giving effect to contribution rights under Section 2.2.

otherFamilyDescription: Non-impairment provision preserving guarantee validity regardless of obligation size, not a substantive covenant family
description: States that fluctuations in the amount of Primary Obligations exceeding a Guarantor's liability do not impair the guarantee or affect the Agent's/Secured Parties' rights and remedies.

otherFamilyDescription: Termination/duration condition for the guarantee obligation
description: Provides that the guarantee remains in full force until Primary Obligations and Guarantor obligations are paid in full (excluding certain Swap Agreement and contingent obligations), no Letters of Credit are outstanding, and Commitments are terminated, notwithstanding periods when no Primary Obligations exist.

otherFamilyDescription: Reinstatement/non-reduction rule preserving guarantor liability despite intervening payments by others
description: Provides that payments made or received from parties other than the relevant Guarantor (via action, proceeding, set-off, or otherwise) do not reduce or release that Guarantor's liability, which continues up to its maximum liability until Primary Obligations are paid in full, Letters of Credit are no longer outstanding, and Commitments are terminated.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantor contribution rights among co-guarantors; not a covenant restricting the borrower/company but an intercreditor-style contribution right.
description: Grants each Subsidiary Guarantor a right to seek contribution from other Subsidiary Guarantors that have not paid their proportionate share of a guaranteed payment.

otherFamilyDescription: Cross-reference limiting the contribution right by another section's terms.
description: The right of contribution described in this section is expressly made subject to the terms and conditions set forth in Section 2.3.

otherFamilyDescription: Preserves full guarantee liability notwithstanding contribution rights; a non-impairment provision for the guarantee obligation.
description: States that the contribution provisions do not limit any Subsidiary Guarantor's obligations and liabilities to the Administrative Agent and Lenders, and each remains liable for the full amount it guaranteed.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee/subordination provision governing subrogation, contribution and reimbursement rights among guarantors and borrowers
description: Each Guarantor waives any right of subrogation, contribution or reimbursement against the Borrower, other Group Members or other Guarantors until all Primary Obligations are paid in full, no Letters of Credit remain outstanding and the Commitments are terminated.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee/subordination provision governing subrogation, contribution and reimbursement rights among guarantors and borrowers
description: Sets the condition precedent (full payment of Primary Obligations, no outstanding Letters of Credit, termination of Commitments) that must be satisfied before a Guarantor's subrogation, contribution or reimbursement rights become effective.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee/subordination provision requiring turnover of prematurely received subrogation payments
description: If a Guarantor receives any payment on account of subrogation rights before the Primary Obligations are paid in full, such amount must be held in trust, segregated, and promptly turned over to the Administrative Agent to be applied against the Primary Obligations.

otherFamilyDescription: Guarantee non-impairment / reinstatement provision governing continuation of guarantor liability despite modifications to the underlying obligations
description: Provides that each Guarantor remains obligated under the guarantee notwithstanding renewals, extensions, amendments, waivers, releases, or other modifications of the Primary Obligations, related collateral, guarantees, or rights of offset made by the Administrative Agent or Lenders without notice to or consent of the Guarantor.

otherFamilyDescription: Waiver of Guarantor's right to require protection or perfection of collateral securing the Primary Obligations
description: States that neither the Administrative Agent nor any Lender has any obligation to protect, secure, perfect, or insure any Lien held as security for the Primary Obligations or the guarantee, effectively waiving any Guarantor defense based on failure to do so.

otherFamilyDescription: Permission for Administrative Agent/Lenders to amend, modify, supplement, or terminate the Credit Agreement and other Loan Documents without affecting Guarantor's obligations
description: Authorizes the Administrative Agent (or Required Lenders/all Lenders as applicable) to amend, modify, supplement, or terminate the Credit Agreement and other Loan Documents in whole or in part as they deem advisable, without releasing the Guarantor.

otherFamilyDescription: Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): GUARANTEE
