otherFamilyDescription: Security/Collateral mechanics - transfer of voting and corporate rights to Agent upon default
description: Upon an Event of Default and notice, the Administrative Agent (or its nominee) may register the Investment Property in its name and exercise all voting, corporate, conversion, exchange, and subscription rights as if it were the absolute owner, with no duty to exercise such rights and no liability except to account for property actually received.

otherFamilyDescription: Security/Collateral mechanics - Issuer instruction upon default
description: Each Grantor authorizes and instructs each Issuer of pledged Investment Property to comply with written instructions from the Administrative Agent stating an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing, without further instruction from the Grantor, and each Issuer is protected in so complying.

otherFamilyDescription: Security/Collateral mechanics - redirection of dividend payments to Agent
description: Unless otherwise expressly permitted under the Agreement, each Issuer is instructed to pay any dividends or other payments with respect to the Investment Property directly to the Administrative Agent rather than the Grantor.

otherFamilyDescription: Establishes the Administrative Agent's authority and the general waterfall mechanism for applying Collateral and guarantee proceeds to Obligations; not a traditional covenant family (debt/liens/restricted payments) but a payment-priority/security enforcement provision.
description: Grants the Administrative Agent authority to apply proceeds of Collateral and the Section 2 guarantee to the Obligations in a specified order, either at agreed intervals or, following an Event of Default, at the Agent's election.

otherFamilyDescription: Payment waterfall - first priority tier for Agent fees/expenses; not tied to a standard covenant family.
description: Directs that proceeds be applied first to pay incurred and unpaid fees and expenses of the Administrative Agent under the Loan Documents.

otherFamilyDescription: Payment waterfall - second priority tier for pro rata payment of due Obligations.
description: Directs that proceeds be applied second, pro rata among Secured Parties, toward Obligations then due and owing and unpaid.

otherFamilyDescription: Payment waterfall - third priority tier for pro rata prepayment of Obligations.
description: Directs that proceeds be applied third, pro rata among Secured Parties according to amounts held, toward prepayment of the Obligations.

otherFamilyDescription: Payment waterfall - residual/fourth tier returning surplus to Borrowers after full satisfaction of Obligations and termination of Commitments.
description: Provides that any balance remaining after the Obligations are paid in full, no Letters of Credit remain outstanding, and Commitments have terminated shall be paid over to the Borrowers or other lawfully entitled parties.

otherFamilyDescription: Carve-out limiting application of guarantor-sourced proceeds; relates to guarantee/security proceeds allocation rather than a standard covenant family.
description: Provides that notwithstanding the foregoing waterfall, no amounts received from any Guarantor shall be applied to that Guarantor's Excluded Swap Obligations.

otherFamilyDescription: This section concerns default remedies and enforcement against collateral rather than a traditional affirmative/negative covenant family (e.g., indebtedness, liens, restricted payments).
description: Upon a continuing Event of Default, permits the Administrative Agent to exercise all rights and remedies of a secured party under the New York UCC or other applicable law in addition to remedies elsewhere granted.

otherFamilyDescription: Remedies/enforcement provision, not a traditional covenant family.
description: Each Grantor waives demand of performance, presentment, protest, advertisement, and notice (except notice required by law) in connection with the Administrative Agent's exercise of remedies.

otherFamilyDescription: Remedies/enforcement provision.
description: Permits the Administrative Agent to collect, receive, appropriate, and realize upon the Collateral and to sell, lease, assign, grant options to purchase, or otherwise dispose of the Collateral in one or more parcels, at public or private sale, on terms and at prices it deems advisable, for cash, credit, or future delivery.

otherFamilyDescription: Remedies/enforcement provision.
description: Grants the Administrative Agent and Lenders the right to purchase the whole or any part of the Collateral at any public sale (and, where permitted, private sale), free of any right or equity of redemption of any Grantor.

otherFamilyDescription: Remedies/enforcement provision.
description: Each Grantor waives and releases any right or equity of redemption with respect to Collateral sold pursuant to this Section.

otherFamilyDescription: Remedies/enforcement provision.
description: Requires each Grantor, upon the Administrative Agent's request, to assemble the Collateral and make it available at a place reasonably selected by the Administrative Agent, including at the Grantor's own premises.

otherFamilyDescription: Remedies/enforcement provision governing application of sale proceeds.
description: Directs that net proceeds from any remedial action be applied first to reasonable costs, expenses and attorneys' fees, then to the Obligations in the order set forth in Section 6.5.

otherFamilyDescription: Remedies/enforcement provision; limits Administrative Agent's duty to account for surplus proceeds.
description: Provides that the Administrative Agent need not account for any surplus to any Grantor until after application of proceeds and payment of any amounts required by law, including UCC Section 9-615(a)(3).

otherFamilyDescription: Remedies/enforcement provision.
description: To the extent permitted by applicable law, each Grantor waives all claims, damages, and demands it may have against the Administrative Agent or any Lender arising from the exercise of remedies under this Section.

otherFamilyDescription: Remedies/enforcement provision establishing a notice safe harbor.
description: Deems any legally required notice of a proposed sale or disposition of Collateral to be reasonable and proper if given at least 10 days before such sale or disposition.

otherFamilyDescription: Collateral enforcement / registration rights covenant ancillary to security interest in pledged stock, not a classic negative covenant family
description: Requires each Grantor to cause the issuer of pledged stock to register the stock under the Securities Act and take related actions if the Administrative Agent decides to sell pledged stock and deems registration necessary or advisable.

otherFamilyDescription: Registration mechanics ancillary to enforcement of pledge
description: Obligates the Grantor to cause the issuer and its directors/officers to execute and deliver all instruments and documents necessary to register the pledged stock as directed by the Administrative Agent.

otherFamilyDescription: Registration mechanics ancillary to enforcement of pledge
description: Requires reasonable best efforts to cause the registration statement to become effective and remain effective for one year from the date of first public offering of the pledged stock.

otherFamilyDescription: Registration mechanics ancillary to enforcement of pledge
description: Requires the Grantor to cause amendments to the registration statement and related prospectus as reasonably deemed necessary or advisable by the Administrative Agent, in conformity with Securities Act rules.

otherFamilyDescription: Blue Sky law compliance and disclosure obligation ancillary to pledge enforcement
description: Requires the Grantor to cause the issuer to comply with state securities (Blue Sky) laws in jurisdictions designated by the Administrative Agent and to make available an earnings statement satisfying Securities Act Section 11(a).

otherFamilyDescription: Waiver/acknowledgment regarding manner of collateral sale, not tied to a standard covenant family
description: Each Grantor acknowledges that private sales of pledged stock may be necessary and less favorable than public sales, and agrees such private sales shall be deemed commercially reasonable, waiving any claim to the contrary.

otherFamilyDescription: Exception to any implied duty to delay enforcement sale for registration
description: Provides that the Administrative Agent has no obligation to delay a sale of pledged stock to permit registration under the Securities Act or state securities laws, even if the issuer would agree to register.

otherFamilyDescription: Best-efforts covenant to effectuate valid sale of pledged collateral
description: Requires each Grantor to use best efforts to take all actions necessary to make sales of pledged stock under this section valid, binding, and compliant with applicable law.

otherFamilyDescription: Waiver of defenses to specific performance of registration covenants
description: Each Grantor waives and agrees not to assert defenses (other than the absence of an Event of Default) against an action for specific performance of the covenants in this Section 6.7, acknowledging irreparable injury and no adequate remedy at law.

otherFamilyDescription: This is a deficiency liability provision related to security/guarantee obligations, not a covenant restricting activity; it concerns liability for shortfall after collateral disposition.
description: Each Grantor remains liable for any deficiency if proceeds from sale or disposition of Collateral are insufficient to cover the Obligations plus collection costs and attorneys' fees.

otherFamilyDescription: Power-of-attorney/collateral-enforcement grant, not a traditional negative covenant family
description: Each Grantor irrevocably appoints the Administrative Agent as its attorney-in-fact with broad power to act in the Grantor's name to accomplish the purposes of the Agreement.

otherFamilyDescription: Condition on exercise of the power-of-attorney grant
description: The Administrative Agent agrees it will not exercise the power of attorney under Section 7.1(a) unless an Event of Default has occurred and is continuing.

otherFamilyDescription: Collateral enforcement power (collection of receivables/instruments)
description: Authorizes the Administrative Agent to take possession of, endorse, and collect checks, drafts, notes and other instruments due under Receivables or other Collateral, and to pursue legal action to collect such amounts.

otherFamilyDescription: Security interest perfection/evidencing power over Intellectual Property
description: Authorizes the Administrative Agent to execute, deliver and record documents evidencing its security interest in the Grantor's Intellectual Property and related goodwill/general intangibles.

otherFamilyDescription: Collateral protection/expense power (taxes, liens, insurance, repairs)
description: Authorizes the Administrative Agent to pay or discharge taxes and liens on the Collateral and to effect repairs or insurance and pay related premiums/costs.

otherFamilyDescription: Transfer-execution power tied to permitted collateral sales
description: Authorizes the Administrative Agent to execute indorsements, assignments or other conveyance instruments in connection with sales of Collateral permitted under Sections 6.6 or 6.7.

otherFamilyDescription: Bundle of enforcement/collection/disposition powers over Collateral
description: Grants a series of enumerated powers (directing payment, collecting amounts, signing documents, litigating, defending, settling, assigning IP, and selling/transferring/pledging Collateral) exercisable by the Administrative Agent as if it were the absolute owner.

otherFamilyDescription: Settlement power over collateral-related claims
description: Authorizes the Administrative Agent to settle, compromise or adjust suits or claims relating to the Collateral and give discharges or releases as it deems appropriate.

otherFamilyDescription: General disposition/ownership-equivalent power over Collateral
description: Authorizes the Administrative Agent to generally sell, transfer, pledge and otherwise deal with the Collateral as if it were the absolute owner, and to take all acts deemed necessary to protect, preserve or realize upon the Collateral and the security interests therein.

otherFamilyDescription: Agent's optional cure right upon default
description: If a Grantor fails to perform its agreements after a Default or Event of Default has occurred and is continuing, the Administrative Agent may (but need not) perform or cause performance of such obligations on the Grantor's behalf.

otherFamilyDescription: Expense reimbursement obligation with interest accrual
description: Requires Grantors to reimburse the Administrative Agent on demand for expenses incurred under Section 7.1, together with interest at the rate applicable to past-due ABR Revolving Credit Loans.

otherFamilyDescription: Ratification and irrevocability of the power-of-attorney grant
description: Each Grantor ratifies all acts done by the attorneys-in-fact and agrees that the powers and agencies granted are coupled with an interest and irrevocable until the Agreement terminates and the security interests are released.

otherFamilyDescription: Agent duty of care standard for collateral custody
description: The Administrative Agent's sole duty regarding custody, safekeeping and physical preservation of Collateral in its possession is to deal with it as it deals with similar property for its own account.

otherFamilyDescription: Liability limitation for Agent/Lenders regarding collection/disposal of collateral
description: Neither the Administrative Agent, any Lender, nor their respective officers, directors, employees or agents shall be liable for failure to demand, collect or realize upon Collateral or for delay in doing so, nor obligated to sell or dispose of Collateral or take any other action regarding it.

otherFamilyDescription: Scope limitation on powers granted to Agent/Lenders
description: The powers conferred on the Administrative Agent and Lenders exist solely to protect their interests in the Collateral and impose no duty to exercise such powers.

otherFamilyDescription: Accountability limitation and gross negligence/willful misconduct carve-out
description: The Administrative Agent and Lenders are accountable only for amounts actually received from exercise of their powers, and are not responsible for any act or failure to act except for their own gross negligence or willful misconduct.

otherFamilyDescription: Administrative/agency provision clarifying agent authority vis-à-vis Grantors and Lenders; not an economic covenant restriction.
description: Clarifies that as between the Administrative Agent and the Lenders, agent actions are governed by the Credit Agreement, while as between the Agent and Grantors the Agent is conclusively presumed to have full authority to act on behalf of Lenders.

otherFamilyDescription: Waiver of inquiry right regarding Administrative Agent's authority; procedural/administrative, not a financial covenant.
description: Each Grantor waives any obligation or entitlement to inquire into the Administrative Agent's authority to act or refrain from acting on behalf of the Lenders.

otherFamilyDescription: Contract amendment/waiver procedural mechanics, not a covenant restricting financial or operational activity
description: Provides that the terms of this Agreement may only be waived, amended, supplemented or modified in accordance with the amendment procedures set forth in Section 10.1 of the Credit Agreement.

otherFamilyDescription: Not a covenant; a boilerplate no-waiver/cumulative remedies clause governing enforcement of rights under the agreement, not a substantive covenant restriction.
description: Provides that no act, delay, or omission by the Administrative Agent or any Lender (other than a written amendment/waiver under Section 8.1) shall be deemed a waiver of any right or remedy or an acquiescence in any Default or Event of Default.

otherFamilyDescription: Boilerplate procedural/enforcement provision, not a covenant restriction.
description: States that no failure or delay in exercising any right, power, or privilege shall operate as a waiver thereof.

otherFamilyDescription: Boilerplate procedural provision regarding cumulative and non-exclusive exercise of remedies.
description: Provides that no single or partial exercise of any right precludes further exercise of that or any other right.

otherFamilyDescription: Boilerplate provision limiting the effect of a prior waiver.
description: Clarifies that a waiver on one occasion is not a bar to exercising the same or another right or remedy on a future occasion.

otherFamilyDescription: General boilerplate stating rights/remedies are cumulative and non-exclusive; not itself a covenant.
description: States that the rights and remedies provided in the agreement are cumulative, may be exercised singly or concurrently, and are not exclusive of other rights or remedies provided by law.

otherFamilyDescription: Expense reimbursement obligation related to enforcement of guarantee, not a substantive covenant family
description: Requires each Guarantor to pay or reimburse the Lenders and Administrative Agent for costs and expenses, including counsel fees, incurred in collecting against or enforcing rights under the guarantee and Loan Documents.

otherFamilyDescription: Tax indemnification obligation related to Collateral, not a substantive covenant family
description: Requires each Guarantor to pay and indemnify the Administrative Agent and Lenders against stamp, excise, sales or other taxes payable in connection with the Collateral or the transactions contemplated by the Agreement.

otherFamilyDescription: General indemnification obligation cross-referenced to Credit Agreement Section 10.5, not a substantive covenant family
description: Requires each Guarantor to indemnify the Administrative Agent and Lenders for liabilities, losses, and expenses relating to execution, enforcement, and administration of the Agreement to the same extent the Parent Borrower is required to do so under Section 10.5 of the Credit Agreement.

otherFamilyDescription: Survival clause, boilerplate rather than an operative covenant
description: States that the indemnification and expense reimbursement agreements in this Section survive repayment of the Obligations and other amounts payable under the Loan Documents.

otherFamilyDescription: General assignment/successors boilerplate clause; not a covenant restricting debt, liens, dividends, etc.
description: Prohibits any Grantor from assigning, transferring, or delegating its rights or obligations under the Agreement without the Administrative Agent's prior written consent.

otherFamilyDescription: This is a set-off/right-of-offset provision, not a traditional debt/lien/restricted-payment covenant family.
description: Each Grantor irrevocably authorizes the Administrative Agent and each Lender, upon and during the continuance of an Event of Default, to set off and apply any deposits, credits, indebtedness or claims held for the Grantor against the Grantor's obligations under the Loan Documents.

otherFamilyDescription: Waiver of notice right ancillary to the set-off authorization.
description: Each Grantor expressly waives any requirement of prior notice before the Administrative Agent or a Lender exercises its set-off rights.

otherFamilyDescription: Procedural condition attached to exercise of set-off rights.
description: The Administrative Agent and each Lender must notify the Grantor promptly after exercising set-off, but failure to give such notice does not invalidate the set-off or application of proceeds.

otherFamilyDescription: Carve-out limiting application of set-off proceeds with respect to swap obligations; depends on the defined term 'Excluded Swap Obligation'.
description: To the extent prohibited by applicable law as described in the definition of 'Excluded Swap Obligation,' no amounts received from or set off against a Guarantor may be applied to that Guarantor's Excluded Swap Obligations.

otherFamilyDescription: Clarifies that set-off rights are cumulative with other remedies available to the secured parties.
description: The set-off rights granted under this Section are cumulative and in addition to any other rights and remedies, including other rights of set-off, available to the Administrative Agent or Lenders.

otherFamilyDescription: Procedural/jurisdictional waiver not tied to a specific covenant family; concerns venue objections in litigation.
description: Each Grantor consents to actions being brought in the specified courts and waives any objection to venue or claim that such venue is inconvenient.

otherFamilyDescription: Procedural waiver regarding acceptable methods of service of process, not an economic covenant.
description: Each Grantor agrees that service of process may be effected by mailing a copy to it at its notice address, effectively waiving stricter service requirements.

otherFamilyDescription: Limits the categories of damages recoverable in litigation arising under the Agreement, functioning as a cap on liability exposure rather than a traditional covenant basket.
description: Each Grantor waives, to the maximum extent permitted by law, any right to claim or recover special, exemplary, punitive, or consequential damages in connection with any related legal proceeding.

otherFamilyDescription: Affirmative covenant mechanism requiring after-acquired/new subsidiaries to join the guarantee and collateral agreement | Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): Other
description: Requires each subsidiary of the Parent Borrower that becomes obligated under Section 6.9 of the Credit Agreement to accede to this Agreement as a Grantor.

otherFamilyDescription: Mechanics for joinder as security/guarantee grantor | Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): Other
description: Conditions such subsidiary's status as a Grantor on execution and delivery of an Assumption Agreement in the form of Annex 1.

Provides that upon full payment of the Loans, Reimbursement Obligations and other Obligations (excluding certain Swap Agreement and contingent/indemnification obligations), termination of Commitments and no outstanding Letters of Credit, the Collateral is released from the Liens and the Agreement terminates automatically without further action.

Requires the Administrative Agent, at the requesting Grantor's expense, to deliver held Collateral and execute documents evidencing termination of the security interest following the release described in the first sentence of (a).

otherFamilyDescription: Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): AssetSales
description: Permits release of the Liens on specific Collateral that is sold, transferred or otherwise disposed of by a Grantor in a transaction permitted under the Credit Agreement, with the Administrative Agent executing releases at the Grantor's expense.

Provides that a Subsidiary Guarantor shall be released from its guarantee obligations under the Agreement if all of its Capital Stock is sold, transferred or otherwise disposed of in a transaction permitted by the Credit Agreement.

Conditions the release of a Subsidiary Guarantor on the Parent Borrower delivering, at least ten Business Days before the proposed release, a written request identifying the guarantor and sale terms plus a certification that the transaction complies with the Credit Agreement and other Loan Documents.

otherFamilyDescription: Procedural jury-trial waiver, not a substantive covenant family (e.g., not related to indebtedness, liens, asset sales, restricted payments, etc.).
description: Each Grantor irrevocably and unconditionally waives the right to trial by jury in any legal proceeding relating to the Agreement or other Loan Documents, including counterclaims.

otherFamilyDescription: Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): OTHER
description: Amends and restates the Existing Guarantee and Collateral Agreement in its entirety, superseding it with this Agreement.

otherFamilyDescription: Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): OTHER
description: Clarifies that execution and delivery of this Agreement is not intended to constitute a novation or accord and satisfaction of the Obligations or other obligations under the Credit Agreement or Loan Documents.

otherFamilyDescription: Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): SECURITY_GRANT
description: Confirms that the Liens described in the Existing Guarantee and Collateral Agreement are carried forward and continue in full force and effect to secure the Obligations.

otherFamilyDescription: Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): SECURITY_GRANT
description: Provides that none of the existing Liens, properties, rights and interests are released, impaired, limited, extinguished or novated, and that they are cumulative with those under this Agreement.

otherFamilyDescription: Unmapped raw family value(s) (normalization phase-2f2-discovery-normalization.v1): OTHER
description: Deems all references to the Existing Guarantee and Collateral Agreement in other Loan Documents to refer instead to this Agreement and its provisions.
